description: Sécurité routière is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. Documents and data available on the State’s website in Saône-et-Loire. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Road safety" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction Départementale des Territoires de Saône-et-Loire. Its keywords include territoires-et-transports, securite-routiere. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2016-02-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
